recovery.name: TWRP
requirements: Unlock the bootloader; use the exact device-specific image.
The official TWRP device page warns that allowing system modifications can prevent the stock kernel from booting because of dm-verity. Read the device instructions before permitting modifications.

stages.title: Install TWRP
stages.optional: Skip if TWRP is already installed.
stages.warning: Replaces the recovery partition. Boot straight into TWRP afterwards: a normal boot restores the stock recovery.
stages.done: TWRP written. Hold Volume Down + Home + Power until the screen is black, then immediately hold Volume Up + Home + Power until TWRP appears.
